Name: The Rock Tumbler
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
[size=4][b]This is a very small mod that adds a new machine to make your stones, gems, and minerals slightly more valuable[/b][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]
Input stone, or any item with the gem or mineral tag into the machine to improve its quality and make a bit more money!
Crafting recipe is purchased for 7500g from the dwarf in the mines.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]
This mod will work with any mod that adds gems or minerals as long as the mod creator correctly assigned context tags to their objects.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI[/*]
[/list] [b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img][/b]

Note: Iridum quality rocks are stupid. but hey. Why not.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332750.png[/img]
